interpretation: Stage 1 identifies 2021-2025 same-industry cointegration evidence; downstream applicability is not its qualification or completion condition.

universe.industry: SW2021 explicit catalogue and historical membership, reconstructed as of 2025-12-31 unless contemporaneous archive proven
universe.coverage: full common trading calendar, valid positive close, actual trading records, reconciled events

adjustment.seed: last valid cumulative factor strictly before first formation session; then apply same-day events
adjustment.missing_seed: backfill evidence to prior event or prove no past action/initial factor; never use future event
adjustment.price_comparison_tolerance: exact Decimal(P_raw)*Decimal(F_returned)==Decimal(Q_API); bound 0 for given records only
adjustment.downstream_coordinate_contract: Any later evaluation must extend the same formation anchor; no OOS access is required for stage 1.
adjustment.residual_variance_audit: Save residual mean/variance/scale. Existing EG numerical-invalid rules remain; future z-standardization eligibility is not a stage-1 discovery filter.
adjustment.comparison_coordinate: raw_price * cumulative_factor versus native hfq API before normalization

candidates.enumeration: all unordered pairs passing predefined data requirements
candidates.direction: lexicographically smaller standard ts_code as A; A on B

unit_root_diagnostic.compatible_rule: level p >= 0.05 and difference p < 0.05; diagnostic compatibility, not proof
unit_root_diagnostic.proof_scope: p_tilde=p on gate, else 1 is marginally conservative under valid original p and fixed family; no gate/EG independence needed; does not prove I(1), model validity or BH dependence

cointegration.pvalue_interpretation: MacKinnon approximate asymptotic, not unconditional finite-sample calibration

zero_p_handling.near_collinearity_or_nonfinite_stat: library value retained; raw_p null; adjustment input 1
zero_p_handling.finite_stat_boundary_or_CDF_zero: retain nominal raw zero with tail_unresolved flag

cointegration.residual_diagnostics_role: statistical relation estimation and numerical audit only

GLOBAL.family: all registered same-L2 candidates across all L2 groups

corrections.input: full frozen raw results with explicitly labelled non-rejection placeholders
corrections.primary_support_comparison: Compare nine views on same-L3 pairs; six views on all pairs
corrections.BH_dependence_guarantee: Conditional; shared-stock dependence does not establish PRDS
corrections.FWER_claim: specified-family nominal control conditional on valid true-null inputs; Holm needs no between-pair independence
corrections.incremental_comparison_scope_current: formation-period statistical evidence and set differences
corrections.main_discovery_definition: valid nominal EG result with reject_L2_Holm=true; no beta, speed, borrow, cost or OOS filter

execution.cuda: permitted only after equivalent-kernel validation; not required or benchmarked

classification.source: official SW2021 catalogue and change-event history
classification.code_namespace: official classification code, not index ticker
classification.boundary_evidence: entry events; no entry on 2025-12-31 in downloaded history; no affected year-end endpoint case
classification.conflicting_effective_events: exclude, never choose by sort order

simulation.residual: e=phi*e_prev+sqrt(1-phi**2)*v, v iid normal; always stationary
simulation.mixed_cluster: j mod5 0/1 cluster1, 2/3 cluster2, 4 unique singleton
simulation.simulation_data_eligibility: fixed complete artificial panel; do not truncate/resample on price sign
simulation.entry_conditions: Simulation stages retain their own engineering/prior-stage completion conditions; these do not require Monte Carlo completion before stage1 list production.
simulation.MCSE_unit: independent whole-panel replicate, not family or pair
simulation.diagnostic_flag: per mechanism AND fixed L2 family, L2-Holm Wilson lower95>.05; diagnostic, not simultaneous guarantee
simulation.relationship_to_production: may run alongside or after stage1 production; separate completion flags
simulation.normalization_formula: Y_gj,t=100*X_gj,t/X_gj,0; each series uses one fixed nonzero constant
simulation.zero_normalization_denominator: engineering-invalid replicate; record and diagnose, do not resample silently
simulation.Wilson_unit: each fixed L2 family over independent whole-panel repetitions; B trials, never family_count*B
simulation.family_average_uncertainty: average within each replicate, then MCSE across replicates; not pooled binomial Wilson

data_correction.task_interruption: rerun same task only if inputs unchanged; never double-count
data_correction.formation_stock_price_or_factor: stock diagnostic; all incident EG tests and parameters; affected full L3/L2 families and all GLOBAL corrections; evidence list and stage1 report
data_correction.eligibility_or_industry: rebuild affected U/H/families and direction; reuse only unaffected identical-input raw tests; recorrect affected domains and all GLOBAL; refresh evidence list
data_correction.downstream_products_if_they_exist: mark affected application sets, baselines, weights or OOS products stale; their reconstruction is not a stage1 completion requirement
data_correction.oos_only_correction: only later-stage paths/events/metrics/reports; do not recompute stage1 unless a formation-input error is independently established
